title: Graduated-Return Step Schedule for the Servicemember Rate Cap Benefit
content:
**Rule.** For a graduated-return line on a Servicemember Rate Cap Benefit of the Hardship Assistance Programs, the graduated-return due dates still to come, counting the one the line is for, are the whole calendar months from the loan's next due date to the recorded end date plus one, none where the recorded end date is empty or falls before that due date; a benefit with at least 3 of them still to come and at least one plan installment line, every one of its plan installment lines fully credited net of plan payments returned on the loan, charges an equal step, one part in the number still to come plus one, of the step up; a benefit with one or two still to come and the same clean line record charges a flat 50 percent of it; any other benefit, including one with a line not fully credited once returned plan payments are taken off, charges the whole step up. The next due date and the returned plan payments are read from the loan's Personal Loans record and payment ledger.

## Schedule

| Graduated-return due dates still to come | Line record (all lines fully credited net of returned plan payments) | Share of the step up charged |
|---|---|---|
| 3 or more | clean | one part in (number still to come plus one) |
| 1 or 2 | clean | 50 percent |
| any | not clean, or no plan installment line | the whole step up |
| none (end date empty or before the next due date) | any | the whole step up |

## Hypothetical figures (loan due on the 15th, clean line record)

| Next due date | Recorded end date | Still to come | Share |
|---|---|---|---|
| 15 August | 15 October | 3 | one part in 4: 25 percent |
| 15 August | 15 November | 4 | one part in 5: 20 percent |
| 15 September | 15 October | 2 | 50 percent |
| 15 October | 15 October | 1 | 50 percent |
